Fig. 2. Overview of the proposed HashSCD framework for scene change detection. Given two images captured at times T0 and T1, augmented views are processed by a shared backbone to extract patch-wise features, which are mapped to local hash embeddings. An XOR-like aggregation is applied to the local hashes to obtain a compact global hash representation for retrieval. During training, contrastive loss is imposed at both patch and global levels. During inference, global hashes are compared using the Hamming distance to determine whether a change occurs, while patch-wise hash differences are used to generate a change heatmap via upsampling.
